admissionInfo.text: Admission to the BSW program includes the following requirements: Completion of all general education courses. Completion of SW 1010 Introduction to Social Work and PSY 1010 General Psychology with a B- grade or higher. Completion of ENGL 1010 Introduction to Academic Writing or ENGL 1005 Foundations of Academic Writing and ENGL 2010 Intermediate Academic Writing with a C+ grade or higher. Overall GPA of 2.5 or higher. Approval of the Social Work Admissions Committee.
